_comment: msgid -> unambiguous English sent to DeepL in its place. The Arabic always comes back from the API; this file only removes an ambiguity the catalogue itself carries. Keys with a gettext context are written as contextmsgid. Checked against the API on 26.10.2026.
_beds: «Bed» in a listing means a bedroom, and DeepL reads the furniture: Bed came back as «the world» on the old model and as «the bed» on the new one.
_distress: «Distress» as a product category has no counterpart: DeepL read it as an emotion and «My distress» came back as «what worries me», «+ Add new distress» as «+ add a new problem».
Distress deals are sold below market pri: Urgent sale deals are sold below market price
A distress listing needs an original pri: An urgent sale listing needs an original price higher than the asking price.
This property is not a distress deal. Be: This property is not an urgent sale deal. Below Market Score :
Hello! I would like a quick consultation: Hello! I would like a quick consultation about an urgent sale of my property.
_secondary: «Secondary» alone reads as a school stage; the market sense has to be named.
_offplan: Three spellings of one term in the catalogue gave three different Arabic phrasings; these pin them to one.
Off Plan Units Listing Page: Listing page for units sold off-plan
_types: Singular labels DeepL turned into something else: Townhouse into «country house», Property into the plural.
_untranslated: Short labels DeepL handed back in English unchanged; Longitude comes along so the pair reads the same way.
_parents: WordPress hierarchy labels: «Parent Developer:» came back as «the main developer», «Parent Property:» lost the word property.
